findings.message: The error from `json.Unmarshal` is ignored, so a malformed or wrongly shaped body (for example an object instead of an array) silently imports nothing and still returns 204 No Content. Clients get a success status for a request that was never processed.
`io.ReadAll(r.Body)` reads the whole request body into memory with no size limit. A client can exhaust server memory by sending a very large body to this bulk endpoint.
Widgets are created one at a time with no transaction. If a `Create` call fails partway through, the earlier widgets stay persisted while the client gets a 500, and a retry will create duplicates.
